rationale: Tests recall of key bony pelvic diameters — a foundational fact for understanding obstetric pelvimetry.
Caldwell-Moloy pelvic type associated with the best prognosis for vaginal delivery is a key clinical fact students must understand.
Knowing the time limits for each stage of labour is foundational for identifying abnormal progress.
Tests recall of the correct order of cardinal movements — a commonly tested sequence in obstetrics.
Pooling test and ferning are the key bedside investigations for PROM — students must be able to select the correct diagnostic approach.
MgSO4 dosing for neuroprotection in preterm labour is a known OG trap; ensures students know the correct indication threshold.
Management threshold for PROM at term vs preterm is a frequently tested decision point.
The action line on the WHO partograph is a core concept for recognising abnormal labour progress.
Contraindication to ARM is a practical safety knowledge point for the skill of amniotomy.
Episiotomy without consent is one of the seven categories of mistreatment in the WRA RMC typology — a key fact for the RMC framework.
LaQshya programme is India's specific operational framework for RMC — students need to know its focus areas.
